parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description:
The subscription duration. Unit: months. Default value: 1. Valid values:

- **1 to 12**

- **24**

- **36**

parameters.name: PaidType
parameters.description:
The billing type. Valid values:

- **0**: subscription.

- **4**: Confluent series subscription.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.
